claims.sectionKey: Pretérito perfeito composto: lectura dependiente del predicado
claims.summary: Bittencourt (2021) reports that in contemporary Brazilian Portuguese data the present-tense ter + participle PPC varies by predicate: stative predicates tend toward durative readings, while non-stative predicates, especially telic ones, can yield iterative readings. The article presents examples and rejects a single invariant interpretation.
